resources.name: Pseudopotentials for W and B (SSSP efficiency or PseudoDojo)

access.notes: Publicly available pseudopotentials (Vanderbilt ultrasoft or PAW) compatible with Quantum ESPRESSO.

Space group P6/mmm (No. 191), lattice parameters a=3.0072 Å, c=3.3799 Å, Wyckoff positions W at 1a (0,0,0), B at 2d (1/3,2/3,1/2). This is publicly known information from the paper and crystallographic databases.
